author: TheOpAmerican
body:
I'm starting a thread here to comment flaws in map gameplay only.

Flowdren[Currently being edited :D] : Move or add monuments into the 2 towers by the spawn. This map goes by too quickly, and as much as I love making a boat and breaking both monuments in under a minute, it makes the map impossible to play (literally)

Ternio: (Suggestion) Add 2 diamond blocks into each little gold cache.

Zao: Add spawn protection. Please.

Illegal Office: Fix the spawn killing thing D:

Diamond Shore: Move the monuments and nerf the pickaxe, another good map that goes by too fast.

Divines: Find a way to incorporate more monuments, the gameplay would be much better with more monuments.

This is all for now, I will update this as people post on it.

EDIT: This is not the place to post glitches you find on maps, do that on github.
